sources: Rapid Ascent. rmxlinux Json/SkillData/sk_wpn_sword_0011 and Json/BuffData buff_wpn_sword_0011 (game 1.6); values SkillPatchTable sk_wpn_sword_0011 (level 9: phy_dmg_up 0.42, dmg_up 0.98). Skills 1–2 (main attribute, Crit Rate) are on the stat panel; sk_wpn_sword_0011 has no cardAttributeModifier: its `buffs` list gives buff_wpn_sword_0011 (lifeType 1, assigned phy_dmg_up and dmg_up) for the whole fight.

buff_wpn_sword_0011 damageModifier 1: CheckDamageDecorateMask checkType 1 mask 768 (battle skill, ultimate) + CheckDamageType 0 (Physical) → NormalCalcZone + phy_dmg_up; damageModifier 2: only CheckPoiseValue compare 1 value 0 on the target (Staggered: no poise left), no mask → NormalCalcZone + dmg_up on every hit. Description: "Battle skills and ultimates gain Physical DMG Dealt +{phy_dmg_up}. Against Staggered enemies, battle skills and ultimates also gain DMG Dealt +{dmg_up}." Interim: the data (every hit against a Staggered enemy); in-game test 85 decides (the description's reading adds onlyKinds [battle, ultimate] to the second modifier).
toggleBuffs buff_wpn_passive_spirit_01 (atk_up, a key sk_wpn_sword_0011 doesn't have): the template leftover with no effect (batch 1). Not in any log.

buffs.label: Rapid Ascent: Physical DMG (battle skill, ultimate) and DMG against Staggered

triggers.note: The skill's `buffs` (lifeType 1): active from the start.
